def factor_float_conditioned_cheapness_winsorized(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    cheapness = 1.0 / df_copy["pb_lf"].replace(0, np.nan)
    float_adj = 1.0 / np.log1p(df_copy["free_float_shares"].clip(lower=1e6))
    debt_ratio = df_copy["debttoassets"] / 100.0
    penalty = 1.0 / (1.0 + debt_ratio)
    raw = cheapness * float_adj * penalty
    low = raw.rolling(252, min_periods=60).quantile(0.01)
    high = raw.rolling(252, min_periods=60).quantile(0.99)
    winsorized = raw.clip(lower=low, upper=high)
    return winsorized.rename("factor_float_conditioned_cheapness_winsorized")
